2609.09684.title: Which Medical Questions Deserve Rationales? Perturbation-Sensitive Selection for Robust QA
2609.09684.paper_summary: Medical question-answering datasets often contain answer labels, whereas high-quality rationales remain scarce, noisy, or costly to validate. This changes the acquisition question: rather than asking which questions should be labeled, we ask which already-labeled questions should receive rationale supervision under a fixed token budget. We study an offline version of this problem in which candidate rationales are visible to the selector but withheld from downstream training unless selected. We propose root-mean-square Robustness-based Sample Prioritization (RMS-RSP), which perturbs hidden states only at rationale tokens and measures the resulting shift in the gold-versus-best-distractor margin. Across five medical QA datasets, MedGemma-4B-IT, three training seeds, ten budgeted non-RSP selectors, and an unbudgeted full-supervision reference, RMS-RSP provides a deliberately qualified result. Its locked-budget accuracy is 60.61% on average versus 60.08% for Random, with a statistically resolved gain only on AfriMed-QA (+1.44 points). Its full-budget accuracy area is not better than Random. However, after three answer-option reorderings, RMS-RSP improves robust accuracy and semantic consistency by 1.91 and 2.85 points on average, respectively, with the same direction on all five datasets. Training on every pool rationale raises macro accuracy to 63.74%, but consumes 29--254 times more rationale tokens and does not uniformly improve robustness. These findings do not establish universal accuracy gains; they instead suggest that rationale-local boundary sensitivity can identify supervision that improves invariance to semantically equivalent formatting changes.
2609.09684.paper_summary_zh: 醫療問答數據集通常包含答案標籤，而高質量的理由則稀缺、嘈雜或驗證成本高。這改變了獲取問題的方式：我們不再詢問哪些問題應該被標記，而是詢問在固定的標記預算下，哪些已標記的問題應該接受理由監督。我們研究了這個問題的離線版本，其中候選理由對選擇者可見，但在未被選擇的情況下不會提供給下游訓練。我們提出了基於均方根穩健性樣本優先級（RMS-RSP），該方法僅在理由標記處擾動隱藏狀態，並測量金標與最佳干擾者邊際的變化。在五個醫療QA數據集、MedGemma-4B-IT、三個訓練種子、十個預算限制的非RSP選擇器和一個不受預算限制的全監督參考中，RMS-RSP提供了一個經過精心篩選的結果。其鎖定預算的準確率平均為60.61%，而隨機方法為60.08%，在AfriMed-QA上僅有統計學上顯著的增益（+1.44點）。其全預算準確率區域不優於隨機方法。然而，在三次答案選項重排序後，RMS-RSP分別提高了1.91和2.85點的穩健準確率和語義一致性，並在所有五個數據集上都朝著相同的方向改進。對每個池理由進行訓練將宏觀準確率提高到63.74%，但消耗的理由標記數量是29到254倍，並且並未均勻改善穩健性。這些發現並未建立普遍的準確性增益；相反，它們表明理由局部邊界敏感性可以識別改善對語義等價格式變化的不變性的監督。
